title: FiniteCoconeLimitBoundaries
statement: For a type-zero bigraded exact couple [def-sp-exact-couple], diagonal alpha cocones A [def-sp-convergence] with invertible structure maps at all sufficiently small first indices on each total-degree diagonal, and any limiting subobjects L, the limiting boundaries L.B(p,q) are the direct image under initialG(p,q) of the kernel of the transported structure map D(p,q) -> A(p+q).obj. No regularity or upper zero tail is assumed.

proof.text: Induct to identify B_r(p,q) with initialG of ker(alphaIter r p q), using iterated image epimorphisms e_r, their canonical inclusions from pageCouple_image_prefix, and DerivedMaps.g_comm/alpha_comm. At a successor, exactness identifies incoming differential images with derived g_r of ker derived alpha_r. Lift representatives along e_r after refinement; the difference from their initial-g image is an old boundary, handled by induction. Conversely a lift killed by alphaIter(r+1) maps to a differential boundary. This is the full finite-boundary chase detailed in the theorem docstring.

Iterate the cocone equation. For all r, ker alphaIter r is contained in ker j_p. For all r with p-r <= the left bound, the tail map is invertible, so these kernels are equal. The boundary range is therefore bounded above by initialG(ker j_p) and contains this eventual value; uniqueness of its LUB proves equality with L.B.

lean.statement:
theorem finiteCocone_limitBoundaries
    {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] [Abelian C]
    (X : BigradedExactCouple C 0) (A : ∀ n : ℤ, X.AlphaColimit n)
    (hleft : ∀ n : ℤ, ∃ a : ℤ, ∀ P : ℤ, P ≤ a → IsIso ((A n).ι P))
    (L : X.LimitSubobjects) (p q : ℤ) :
    L.B p q = (Subobject.«exists» (X.initialG p q)).obj
      (kernelSubobject (eqToHom (by congr 1; omega) ≫ (A (p + q)).ι p))
